description: Record a durable continue or resume request for a Martin run after a human pause or approval checkpoint.
name: martin_continue

action.description: The control action that was recorded.

controlId.description: Unique receipt ID for this control action.

loopId.description: MartinLoop run identifier the control was applied to.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for the control, if provided.

requestedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the control was recorded.

requestedBy.description: Identity that requested the control, if provided.
